svg.text: Shared monotonic clock · application measurements · time in seconds from first recorded event
Link down → barrier-confirmed route 1.112 ms · route → useful ACK 199.384 ms
Green = installing the route · blue = waiting for useful ACK progress
An upward ACK line means more of the file is confirmed. A flat stretch means the contiguous prefix has stopped advancing.
Blue lines: measured application state · retry dots: amber fast gap / red timeout · congestion window belongs to this UDP implementation.
